# Analysis delivery under change

The finance analyst receives two extracts with changed currency units and status rules. Reproduce both versions and explain which totals may be compared.

## Input and contract
input/fixture.json; input/dictionary.md; project version 1

## Finding and reproducible output
```json
[
  {
    "version": "v1",
    "unit": "yuan",
    "count": 1,
    "cents": 12000
  },
  {
    "version": "v2",
    "unit": "cent",
    "count": 2,
    "cents": 17000
  }
]
```

## Failure prevented
Treating yuan as cents silently changes the monetary scale.

## Decision and limits
Accept only the specified result set. Escalate a missing identity, permission, business probe or required not-run item. This is an original synthetic teaching reference, not evidence of learner execution or real employment.

files.query.sql: SELECT version,unit,COUNT(*) AS count,SUM(CASE WHEN unit='yuan' THEN amount*100 ELSE amount END) AS cents FROM version_rows WHERE status='active' GROUP BY version,unit ORDER BY version;
